Scenario.Name: Largo
Scenario.Author: EcoKnow
Scenario.Description: Hand-authored 80x40 catchment-style water test scenario based on the Largo geographical map: two 2-tile-wide freshwater rivers descend from the north, merge into a single river that first sweeps east and then runs south to a 2-tile-wide sand band wrapping the bay in a crescent; below the sand band sits a seawater bay (also crescent-shaped). Everything else is grass. Freshwater renders over Soil; seawater renders over Sand (per TerrainPriority.ZoneTerrainStacks). The Freshwater terrain reuses a duplicate of the seawater tileset until a dedicated freshwater tileset exists. SOURCE OF TRUTH: Map_Largo.csv (zone definitions + tile layout) and the four largo_*.csv matrix files. This JSON is a snapshot of those sources; regenerate it if the source CSVs change.

WinConditions.Title: Inspect Water Features
WinConditions.Description: Visual test scenario: confirm the two freshwater rivers merge cleanly, the merged river bends right then runs south to the sand, and the crescent-shaped sand band & bay tile correctly at every boundary.
